title: Rail-Data-Core, domain electrification 2.0
description: The electrification of the tracks, planned in the Catenary-Tool (decision 0025): which ranges carry a contact wire, and its system. Depends on core; its references go into the core only. Later the masts, cantilevers, wires and sections. — 2.0 (decision 0028): on core 3.0, a lifespan states days.

Electrification.description: A range of a track under a contact wire (or a conductor rail) of one system. `system` is the voltage as OSRD names a traction mode: 15000V the 15 kV 16.7 Hz of DB, ÖBB and SBB, 25000V 25 kV 50 Hz, the others direct current. A train runs electrically where its vehicle has the mode.
